meta_title: Oakey Dokey Tree Services | Arborist Birmingham
meta_description: Oakey Dokey Tree Services in Birmingham offers expert tree surgery, pruning, felling and stump removal. Local arborists with fast response times. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Certified Arborist — Emergency Tree Surgery Available
hero_subhead: Dangerous branches threatening your property? We remove trees, clear storm damage and prune safely — often same day in Birmingham.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From routine pruning and hedge trimming to emergency felling and stump removal, we handle every aspect of tree care with safety and precision.

services.title: Emergency Tree Felling
services.desc: Storm damage, dangerous branches or diseased trees posing a risk to your home or neighbours. We remove hazardous trees safely and dispose of the debris.

services.title: Tree Pruning & Crown Reduction
services.desc: Keep trees healthy and manageable. We prune to promote growth, improve light and air flow, and reduce wind resistance without compromising the tree's structure.

services.title: Stump Removal & Grinding
services.desc: Left with an unsightly stump? We grind it out below ground level so you can replant, pave or simply reclaim your garden space.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Overgrown hedges blocking light or views? Regular trimming keeps hedges neat, healthy and within boundary lines. We dispose of all clippings.

services.title: Deadwood Removal
services.desc: Dead branches are a safety hazard. We remove deadwood carefully to prevent limbs falling and reduce disease spread through the tree.

services.title: Tree Surgery Aftercare
services.desc: After major work, your tree needs attention. We advise on feeding, mulching and ongoing care to help established trees recover and thrive.

about_pullquote: We've earned our reputation by turning chaos into safe, tidy gardens every single day.
about_para_1: Oakey Dokey Tree Services has been removing and maintaining trees across Birmingham and the surrounding area for nearly two decades. Founded by a qualified arborist frustrated by poor standards in the trade, we built the business on safety, honesty and getting the job done right the first time. Every member of our team is trained in modern climbing and felling techniques, and we hold full public liability insurance and adhere to industry safety standards.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on turning dangerous or overgrown trees into safe, attractive gardens — and charging a fair price for it. We turn up on time, bring everything we need, work safely around your property, and clean up thoroughly before we leave. Many of our customers call us back year after year for seasonal pruning and maintenance, which tells you we're doing something right.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Oakey Dokey

reviews.text: Had a massive oak leaning dangerously over our fence after the storm. Called Oakey Dokey on a Friday afternoon and they came out Saturday morning. Felled it safely, chipped all the wood and left our garden spotless. Brilliant service. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our hedge was completely out of control, blocking half our light. The lads trimmed it back to shape in one day, removed all the waste and gave me advice on keeping it tidy. Very reasonable price and they clearly knew what they were doing. Top marks.
reviews.author: Charlotte M.

reviews.text: Stump was sitting in our garden for months. Called these guys and they ground it out, cleared the debris and the spot is ready to pave now. Professional job, no fuss. Would use them again for sure.
reviews.author: David W.
